name: ai.privos.meeting-agent
title: PrivOS Meeting App
description: A PrivOS MCP app for offline meeting capture: bilingual live captions with speaker labels, cross-session speaker identity via voiceprints, Hub-AI summaries, and transcript storage in PrivOS Files.

dataPolicy.retention: By default speech is recognised inside the app container (built-in Vietnamese/English models) and audio never leaves the workspace. Only if a room selects Soniox or ElevenLabs is audio streamed and uploaded to that provider, which keeps it under its own terms; the app deletes its Soniox upload after transcription. Recording parts are deleted once merged. The merged audio is deleted right after processing unless the room enables Keep original audio; audio kept on purpose, or left because the summary failed, is deleted after the room's auto-delete period (default 90 days, 0 disables). Parts of an interrupted recording are deleted after 7 days by default. Transcripts and summaries are produced with Hub AI inside the workspace and stored in the room's Files until the meeting is deleted, by its owner or after the room's meeting auto-delete period (off by default). Voiceprints (speaker embeddings, biometric data) can be turned off per room, in which case none are computed or stored; while on, the recorder must confirm before each recording that participants were told, and the confirmation time is kept on the meeting. Voiceprints are encrypted with AES-256-GCM, stored in the workspace App DB and never sent outside the workspace; deleting a meeting also removes the voice samples taken from it, and a profile stays until its creator or a workspace admin deletes it. Unconfirmed speaker embeddings are cleared 30 days after the meeting. Temporary files on the app volume are deleted after each job; operator diagnostics are kept for 90 days. Uninstalling the app does not delete data already stored in the room's Files or App DB.

permissions.reason: Identify the current user and open room to load the right meeting data.
Read and stream back audio, transcripts, and summaries stored in the room's Files.
Upload audio parts, merged audio, transcripts, and summaries to the room's Files.
Check App DB collection schemas before registering them.
Register App DB collections (meetings, speakers, voiceprint profiles, processing jobs).
Read the list of meetings, speakers, and job status for display.
Write meetings, speakers, encrypted voiceprint profiles, action items, decisions, and job status.
Summarize and translate in batches with Hub AI, without sending transcripts to third parties.
Push the bot key to PrivOS Sandbox at init to pre-provision the Hub AI VM (without it, summary/translation report 'container unavailable').
permissions.degradedBehavior: Ask an admin to push the bot key manually; Hub AI summary/translation stays unavailable until the VM is provisioned.

permissions.reason: Show the room member list when assigning speaker names.
permissions.degradedBehavior: The user types a name freely instead of picking from the member list.

permissions.reason: Let only the room's owners and moderators, and workspace admins, change the room's speech-to-text, speaker and retention settings.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Nobody can change the room's settings in the app; the room keeps its current values or the defaults, and the Settings screen shows them read-only.

permissions.reason: Read Smart Lists to push action items.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Hide the Push to Smart List button.

permissions.reason: Create and write items into the "Meeting action items" Smart List.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Hide the Push to Smart List button.

permissions.reason: meeting_bootstrap adds the installation bot to the room so it can write Files.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Ask an admin to add the bot to the room manually; processing pauses until the bot joins.

permissions.reason: Read the bot identity to verify its credential and show status.
permissions.degradedBehavior: A banner guides configuring the bot credential.

permissions.reason: Send the meeting summary to the room chat via the installation bot.
permissions.degradedBehavior: Hide the Send to chat button.

tools.name: meeting_agent
tools.title: Meeting Agent
tools.description: Open the app to record and review meetings in this room.

tools.name: meeting_agent_bot_credential_check
tools.title: Check bot credential
tools.description: Check the installation bot's credential against the Hub.

tools.name: meeting_bootstrap
tools.title: Bootstrap room data
tools.description: Register the App DB schema, record the room, and ensure the bot is a room member.

tools.name: meeting_stt_status
tools.title: Speech-to-text status
tools.description: Status of both STT providers for room owners, moderators and workspace admins to compare.

tools.name: meeting_realtime_token
tools.title: Get live caption token
tools.description: Mint a short-lived realtime token for the selected STT provider's live caption SDK.

tools.name: meeting_chunk_ready
tools.title: Report recording part ready
tools.description: Receive and validate the turns of a just-uploaded recording part.

tools.name: meeting_live_speakers
tools.title: Live speakers
tools.description: List of speakers detected during the meeting, with names when matched to a voiceprint profile.

sinceMs.description: Only return settled turns newer than this meeting-clock timestamp. Omitted -> the most recent turns.

tools.name: meeting_translate
tools.title: Translate live captions
tools.description: Translate a batch of finalized caption lines with Hub AI when the STT provider doesn't translate bilingually in realtime.

tools.name: meeting_process
tools.title: Process meeting
tools.description: Merge recording parts, identify speakers, and produce the meeting transcript with the selected STT provider.

tools.name: meeting_status
tools.title: Meeting processing status
tools.description: View meeting processing progress: current step, percent complete, and the result when finished.

tools.name: meeting_summarize
tools.title: Re-summarize meeting
tools.description: Re-run only the summary step with Hub AI from the saved transcript, without reprocessing everything.

tools.name: meeting_live_summary
tools.title: Live meeting summary
tools.description: Summarize the meeting so far from live captions, without a saved transcript — used for the summary panel refreshed about every 10 minutes.

tools.name: meeting_send_to_chat
tools.title: Send summary to chat
tools.description: Send the saved meeting summary to the room chat via the installation bot — the content is built server-side, never taken from the client.

tools.name: meeting_settings_set
tools.title: Update room settings
tools.description: Write a setting for the caller's room (STT provider, speaker-match thresholds, retention…) — room owners, moderators and workspace admins only.

tools.name: speaker_resolve
tools.title: Resolve speakers
tools.description: Confirm, name, or merge a meeting's unidentified speakers into voiceprint profiles.

tools.name: speaker_profile_list
tools.title: List voiceprint profiles
tools.description: List every voiceprint profile in the workspace (name, links, sample count) — never returns the vector.

tools.name: speaker_profile_update
tools.title: Update voiceprint profile
tools.description: Rename, link a PrivOS user, re-enrol, or prune bad voice samples for a profile — only the profile creator or a workspace admin.

tools.name: speaker_profile_delete
tools.title: Delete voiceprint profile
tools.description: Permanently delete a voiceprint profile and all its links across every room — only the profile creator or a workspace admin.

tools.name: meeting_relabel_speaker
tools.title: Relabel speaker
tools.description: Change a meeting's speaker to the correct profile or a different name, and update the matching voiceprint profile.

tools.name: meeting_forget_voiceprints
tools.title: Forget meeting voiceprints
tools.description: Remove every voice sample taken from this meeting from the workspace's voiceprint profiles — run before deleting the meeting; only the meeting owner.

tools.name: meeting_audio_push
tools.title: Push live audio
tools.description: Send a short chunk of the meeting's live audio to the app's own speech recognizer and receive the new captions — only the meeting owner, while recording.
